declarations.docstring: There exists a nonzero scalar such that the square of the displayed product equals its scalar multiple.
The auxiliary submodule equals the span of the singleton containing the displayed product.
A linear equivalence from the auxiliary submodule to the span of the singleton containing the displayed product.
A linear equivalence from the auxiliary submodule to the indexed submodule.
A submodule indexed by a natural number and a partition of that number.
The indexed submodule equals the span of the singleton containing the displayed product.
The module carried by the indexed submodule is simple.
The displayed auxiliary element does not vanish.
